narrative.overview: Ora is a quiet room with one light in it. Surfaces are ivory paper tinted warm, text is a deep ink-blue rather than black, and gold is spent like a single flame. Day is ivory and blue; night is the same room with the lamps turned down.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory ground, ink-blue text, gold as a rare point of light.
Flat tonal layering; depth comes from tinted surfaces and big corners, not shadows.
One repeated shape: the chapel-window arch.
Fully pill-shaped actions with 48–56px touch targets.
Serif for what is prayed, sans for what is operated.
Slow, opacity-and-transform-only motion that disappears under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Gold appears as a point, a ring, a rule or a halo, never as a surface fill larger than an icon backing.

rules.name: The Season Owns the Hue Rule
rules.body: Components use tokens, never a literal blue or green, so a season swap recolors every surface with no component edits.

rules.name: The Ink, Not Black Rule
rules.body: Text is never #000 and grounds are never #fff; both are tinted toward the palette hue.

rules.name: The Sacred Text Is Serif Rule
rules.body: Anything prayed is Source Serif 4 and scales with --prayer-scale. UI chrome never uses it.

rules.name: The Scale Is Theirs Rule
rules.body: Layouts around prayer text must reflow, never clip or truncate it.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: In-flow surfaces get tone, never a shadow. Only overlays that cover the page may cast one.

dos: Do use semantic tokens so seasons and night mode recolor everything for free.
Do set prayer text with .prayer-text and let --prayer-scale govern its size.
Do keep every interactive target at 44px or more and use AppButton.
Do animate with opacity and transform only, on ease-ora, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep gold to a point, ring, rule or halo.
Do use tonal steps (card → secondary → accent) to separate surfaces.
donts: Don't add shadows to in-flow cards or buttons.
Don't introduce streak flames, badges, confetti or any gamified visual.
Don't paraphrase, truncate, restyle or auto-generate traditional prayer text.
Don't put an arch on a button.
Don't fill large areas with gold or add a second accent hue.
Don't animate layout properties or run more than one ambient motion on a screen.
